key_highlights: Bond market volatility rattles Wall Street; ASX expected to follow lower ahead of jobs data
RBA signals further rate hikes as inflation pressures persist, squeezing household spending
ASX closed flat: miners rose while oil stocks struggled; IDP (IDP.AX) plunged
Trump diesel export ban threatens Australian fuel supply and raises cost-of-living fears
Australian flash PMI sags, signalling softening economic momentum
Gold miners surge: Critical Resources (CRG.AX) and Aurum (AUG.AX) on new project funding
Property market cools as rising listings meet falling demand
Jetstar (JLH.AX) industrial action escalates with staff waiving fees in protest
Global risk-off: world economy growing wary of US policy instability

sectors.trend: Miners rose to close ASX flat; gold names surged on project funding (CRG.AX, AUG.AX); rare earths (JUP.AX) gained on Critica offtake progress. Iron ore and coal muted amid global demand concerns.
sectors.implications: Gold and critical minerals offer relative strength; broad materials exposure remains sensitive to Chinese property recovery signals and global growth fears.

sectors.trend: RBA rate hike expectations support net interest margins but squeeze household spending and credit growth. Bond market volatility pressures equity valuations. Financial stocks fell in global session.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face a trade-off: higher NIM vs. rising credit risk and weaker loan demand. Bond yield volatility adds mark-to-market risk.

sectors.trend: Oil stocks struggled as crude sold off on Middle East diplomatic hopes. Trump diesel export ban creates structural supply risk for Australia. Fuel price fears mount as global buffers dry up.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, XAR.AX face headwinds from lower crude but tailwinds from diesel scarcity premium. Policy debate (energy cost 'lie') adds political risk.

sectors.trend: Syngenis (SYG.AX) gains precision medicine venture firepower. Migrant doctors filling GP gaps highlights structural workforce issues. OpenAI/Medicare breach raises data security concerns.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor; SYG.AX and smaller biotech names benefit from R&D momentum. Medicare breach may accelerate health-tech spending.

sectors.trend: Jetstar (JLH.AX) industrial action escalates. RBA hikes squeeze discretionary spending. Qantas (QAN.AX) announces Sydney-New York non-stop. Fuel cost fears pressure transport margins.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX face margin pressure from fuel and wage costs. JLH.AX faces operational disruption risk. QAN.AX benefits from route expansion.

sectors.trend: Rising listings and falling demand drive property prices lower. El Niño threatens agricultural output. Data centre energy demand strains net-zero targets.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. Agricultural REITs exposed to El Niño risk. Data centre demand supports select infrastructure plays.

sectors.trend: $16B Aussie tech firm faces China-link controversy. AI disruption narrative intensifies (Obama on job displacement). Nine TV (NINE.AX) leadership churn.
sectors.implications: Local tech names face geopolitical scrutiny. AI theme supports global names but raises structural unemployment concerns for Australian labour market.

key_themes: Bond market volatility and RBA hawkish pivot
Trump trade policy (diesel ban) as Australian supply-chain risk
Gold and critical minerals as inflation/geopolitical hedges
Energy cost political risk and fuel supply concerns
AI disruption and data security (Medicare breach)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA further rate hikes amid sticky inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; favour banks with strong NIM; underweight rate-sensitive REITs and property developers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Trump diesel export ban / fuel supply disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor WDS.AX, WLE.AX for diesel premium; hedge transport exposure; watch RBA fuel-inflation pass-through

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global bond market volatility / US policy instability
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce leverage; increase cash allocation; diversify into gold (GOLD.AX, WES.AX gold exposure)
Favour defensive sectors (healthcare, staples); monitor jobs data for RBA path confirmation
Underweight property developers; favour REITs with diversified income streams; monitor housing starts data
Avoid JLH.AX near-term; monitor QAN.AX as substitute demand beneficiary

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven bid and project funding catalysts
opportunities.rationale: Bond volatility, US policy risk, and new project funding (CRG.AX Suriname, AUG.AX $52.5M) support gold equities

opportunities.recommendation: Position in critical minerals / rare earths on offtake progress
opportunities.rationale: JUP.AX Critica offtake and broader critical minerals theme benefit from supply-chain diversification away from China

opportunities.recommendation: Selective bank exposure for NIM benefit from RBA hikes
opportunities.rationale: Further rate hikes support net interest margins; CBA and NAB best positioned for credit quality

opportunities.recommendation: Healthcare defensive positioning via CSL and SYG
opportunities.rationale: Syngenis precision medicine venture adds optionality; CSL provides defensive income in volatile tape

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce oil/energy equity exposure; hedge fuel cost risk
defensive_moves.rationale: Crude selling off on Middle East diplomacy; diesel ban creates asymmetric downside for refiners

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight property developers and rate-sensitive REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising listings, falling demand, and RBA hikes create triple headwind for property sector

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid JLH.AX; rotate to QAN.AX for aviation exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Industrial action creates near-term operational and reputational risk for Jetstar
Bond market volatility and RBA uncertainty favour capital preservation

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to trade lower as bond market volatility and RBA hawkishness dominate. Miners and gold provide relative strength. Oil stocks and property remain under pressure. Jobs data release is the key near-term catalyst. Expect elevated volatility into month-end.
market_outlook.long_term: RBA rate cycle peaking supports financials but caps growth. Property correction may extend 6-12 months. Gold and critical minerals remain structurally supported by geopolitical fragmentation. Energy transition and AI disruption create sector rotation opportunities. Chinese property recovery is a key swing factor for iron ore and BHP/RIO.
